verdict.rationale: Exa documents a Contents API that returns clean page content from URLs, handling JavaScript-rendered pages, PDFs and complex layouts. The same contents features can be requested inline from Search for returned results at no extra charge, up to 10 results per search. A trial user feeding results into a chatbot asked for a cruft cleaner, which implies they were receiving page content beyond snippets. Missing for 10: an explicit markdown output format, documentation that full untruncated text (not only highlights or excerpts) is returned, and independent hands-on confirmation of full-text quality.
